title: stem() strips a repeated final digit, so a build number 26100 is indexed as 2610 and 544 as 54
goal: kbfacts.terms keeps a number whole: 'terms("26100")' is ['26100'] and 'terms("S-1-5-32-544")' holds no token ending 54, so the double-letter rule of stem() touches words only

gates.question: How does stem() keep a number whole: which guard on the double-letter rule?
options: isalpha guard on the final character of the double-letter rule only
return a token that holds a digit unstemmed before every rule
guard the double-letter rule by a digit test on the whole word
gates.recommendation: isalpha guard on the final character of the double-letter rule only
gates.answer: isalpha guard on the final character of the double-letter rule only
